snippet.title: Ye Guild Clerk! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Now announcing Ye Guild Clerk! A 2.5D, casual, interactive visual novel, and medieval job simulator made by a group of college students! (now graduates!)

You play as the guild clerk, where you’ll meet a wide range of cute animal adventurers. You'll hand out quests, items, and gold that shape their journey and your relationship with the characters!

Release Date - October 28, 2025

Play now!
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3715020/Ye_Guild_Clerk/
_____________________________________________________________________

Follow our Socials!
Discord: https://discord.gg/pmkJjHj8fr
